none: PAS DENO-959A4D: Roman possible Aucissa brooch
contea di ritrovamento: Leicestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper alloy Roman brooch, possibly of the Aucissa type, dating to the 1st century AD (c. AD 43-75). The rolled-forward cylindrical wings, the rectangular head and part of the upper bow are preserved. The cylinder contains an iron axis bar for the pin and one of its wings is broken while the other is missing its terminal. Most of the pin is missing apart from the hinge end. The bow…
